test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19db9f32b74afa960d89e57b28df14e0a0f98bf746497ae33b98826d8a7fdd09.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series → The elements shift row wise in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/787a5baa1c14f9316f405b24ebe29557ca835cfa4f8ee52932d57886b6e1688b.png] 

2) Second box series →

One element is eliminated from the 1st row.

The number of elements is 2nd row is doubled.

One element is added to the 3rd row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a3cb29f5cbe448ac4e1217a25440d0402cc17d9a30b91a9fca14c69935f0589.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e985f5be701a76018eb0b1630178138aea478853d5a06ab3e0740881e75fde5.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
